p1.titolo: Do you know where your money goes?
p1.testo: TrackIt tells you. No spreadsheets, no hassle.

p2.titolo: Type expenses the way you'd say them
p2.testo: TrackIt does the rest: amount, date and category.

p3.testo: Every expense updates your monthly budget in real time.

p4.testo: We remind you the day before. Cancel what you no longer use in time.
p4.testoWeb: Every renewal is logged automatically. Cancel what you no longer use in time.

p5.testo: Free account. Your data stays yours: export or delete it anytime.

scarta.testo: Your changes haven't been saved and will be lost.

home.suggerimentoAssistente: Log an expense by typing it in your own words
home.nessunBudgetTesto: Tap + New to decide how much to spend each month and see what's left
home.nessunaSpesaTesto: Tap the + button below to add your first expense
home.esciTesto: Do you want to close the app?
home.erroreCaricamento: Couldn't load your data. Check your connection.

tour.introTesto: I'll show you where everything is in a few seconds.

assistente.testo: Try it now: type your first expense in your own words.

aggiungi.testo: Tap + to enter it by hand, subscriptions too.

budget.testo: Decide how much to spend and the day your month starts.

abbonamenti.testo: Pause them, edit them and confirm the ones to renew.

promemoria.testo: Switch them on here: we'll remind you the day before each renewal.

profiloWeb.testo: Here you can export your data and watch this tour again.

statistiche.testo: See how you spent your budget, month by month.

occhio.testo: Handy in public. Your choice is kept when you reopen the app.

invitoHome.titolo: Add TrackIt to your Home Screen
invitoHome.testo: It opens like an app, full screen.
